Prealgebra · Lesson 9.1

Percents as Fractions

Solve this lesson →All lessons

Percent means per hundred, from the Latin per centum. So 73%73% is literally 7310010073​, a fraction whose denominator is 100100. The %% sign is just a stand-in for that /100/100.

Problem
Your phone storage is 80%80% full. Write 80%80% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show a hint
  • The word percent means "per hundred," so put the number over 100. That gives you 8010010080​, and now it is just a fraction waiting to be simplified.
  • Both 80 and 100 are divisible by 20. Divide the top by 20 and the bottom by 20 to land on the smallest equivalent fraction.
Show the full solution
80%80% means 80 per hundred, so 80%=8010080%=10080​. The greatest common factor of 80 and 100 is 20, so divide the top and the bottom by 20. 80100=80÷20100÷20=4510080​=100÷2080÷20​=54​ So the answer is 4/54/5​. Reducing does not shrink the amount, it just names the same slice of storage with smaller numbers.
Problem
A bakery sold 250%250% as many sourdough loaves as last Saturday. Percents can exceed 100100. Write 250%250% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show a hint
  • A percent means that many hundredths, so 250%250% is the same as 250100100250​. Going above 100100 is allowed, it simply gives a fraction larger than 11.
  • Now reduce 250100100250​. Both the top and bottom share a factor of 5050, so divide each by 5050.
Show the full solution
A percent is a number of hundredths, so 250%=250100250%=100250​. The greatest common factor of 250250 and 100100 is 5050, so divide the top and the bottom by 5050. 250100=250÷50100÷50=52100250​=100÷50250÷50​=25​ So 250%250% in lowest terms is 5/25/2​. Going past 100100 is fine, it just means more than one whole, and 5225​ is 2.52.5, the two and a half times the bakery sold.
Problem
A glacier retreated by −45%−45% over a decade. A percent can be negative. Write −45%−45% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show a hint
  • Start from the meaning. −45%−45% means −45−45 out of 100100, so write it as −45100100−45​. The negative sign just rides along on top.
  • Now reduce −45100100−45​. Both 4545 and 100100 share a factor of 55, so divide each by 55 and keep the minus sign.
Show the full solution
−45%−45% means −45−45 out of 100100, so −45%=−45100−45%=100−45​. Both 4545 and 100100 are divisible by 55, and dividing gives −45÷5100÷5=−920100÷5−45÷5​=20−9​. Since 99 and 2020 share no factor bigger than 11, that is lowest terms, so −9/20−9/20​. The minus sign rides along on the numerator and changes nothing about how you reduce.
Key idea
Percent means per hundred. The word comes from the Latin per centum. So x%x% is another way of writing the fraction x100100x​, and the %% sign stands in for the denominator. To turn a percent into a fraction, write it over 100100 and divide the top and bottom by their greatest common factor until nothing else divides both. The numerator does not have to fall between 00 and 100100, because the 100100 is the denominator, not a maximum. More than one whole is more than 100%100%, so 250%=250100=52250%=100250​=25​. A percent can also be negative.
Problem
A coupon takes 38%38% off. Rewrite 38%38% as a decimal.
Show a hint
  • A percent is a count per hundred, so 38%=38100=38÷10038%=10038​=38÷100. You are not taking the percent of any price yet, just rewriting the number itself.
  • Dividing by 100100 slides the decimal point two places to the left. Picture 3838 as 38.38. and hop that point left twice, filling the empty spot with a zero.
Show the full solution
38%=38100=38÷10038%=10038​=38÷100, and dividing by 100100 moves the decimal point two places to the left. Start at 38.38., hop the point left once to get 3.83.8, then left again to land at 0.380.38. So 38%=0.3838%=0.38​.
Problem
A bridge sensor drifts by 0.4%0.4%. Write 0.4%0.4% as a decimal.
Show a hint
  • A percent means "divided by one hundred", so dividing by 100100 slides the decimal point two places to the left. Start from 0.40.4 and move the point.
  • Moving the point in 0.40.4 two places left runs out of digits, so fill the empty spots with zeros. You get 0.4→0.04→0.0040.4→0.04→0.004.
Show the full solution
A percent is a count out of one hundred, so 0.4%0.4% means 0.41001000.4​. Dividing by 100100 slides the decimal point two places to the left. Starting at 0.40.4, one slide gives 0.040.04 and a second slide gives 0.0040.004, with zeros filling the empty places. So 0.4%=0.0040.4%=0.004​.
Problem
Your fitness app shows daily goal progress as the decimal 0.410.41. Write 0.410.41 as a percent. Give just the number.
Show a hint
  • A percent is a count out of one hundred, so to name a decimal as a percent you multiply it by 100100. Multiplying by 100100 slides the decimal point two places to the right.
  • Slide the point in 0.410.41 two places right. It moves past the 44 and past the 11, landing after the 11, which leaves 4141.
Show the full solution
A decimal becomes a percent when you multiply it by 100100, and multiplying by 100100 just slides the decimal point two places to the right. Start with 0.410.41. Slide the point past the 44 to get 4.14.1, then past the 11 to get 4141. So 0.41×100=410.41×100=41, which means 0.41=41%0.41=41%. The answer is 4141​.
Problem
A race lap timer reads 0.0730.073 of the way through the final lap. Write 0.0730.073 as a percent. Give just the number.
Show a hint
  • To go from a decimal to a percent, multiply by 100100, which slides the decimal point two places to the right. Start by moving it from 0.0730.073 one place, then a second place.
  • Sliding 0.0730.073 two places right gives 007.3007.3. Drop the leading zeros and you are left with a number that still has a digit after the point.
Show the full solution
To make a decimal into a percent, multiply by 100100, which slides the decimal point two places to the right. From 0.0730.073, one slide gives 0.730.73 and a second gives 7.37.3, so 0.073=7.3%0.073=7.3% and the number you type is 7.37.3​. There were three digits after the point, so only two of them clear it and the last one stays behind in the tenths place. That is why the percent is itself a decimal.
Key idea
Percent ↔↔ decimal. To turn a percent into a decimal, divide by 100100. That moves the decimal point two places to the left, padding with zeros when you run out of digits, so 38%=0.3838%=0.38 and 6%=0.066%=0.06. To go back, multiply by 100100 and move the decimal point two places to the right. If you forget which direction to move it, use the meaning of the word, since 38%38% is 3838 out of 100100, which is 0.380.38.
Fun fact
The %% sign is a frozen abbreviation. Italian merchants wrote per c., which blurred across centuries into the slashed pair of zeros used today. The cousin sign ‰ means per thousand.
Problem
A garden bed is 3443​ planted. A percent has a hidden denominator of 100100. Write 3443​ as a percent. Give just the number.
Show a hint
  • You want the same fraction with a denominator of 100100. Ask yourself what 44 must be multiplied by to reach 100100, and remember to multiply the top by that same number.
  • Since 4×25=1004×25=100, multiply top and bottom by 2525. That gives 3×254×25=751004×253×25​=10075​, and the numerator over 100100 is the percent.
Show the full solution
Rewrite 3443​ as an equal fraction whose denominator is 100100. Since 4×25=1004×25=100, multiply the top and bottom by the same 2525. 34=3×254×25=75100.43​=4×253×25​=10075​. A fraction over 100100 is read directly as a percent, so 75100=75%10075​=75%. The percent is 7575​.
Problem
A bakery scales a recipe to 8558​ of the original. Since 85>158​>1, the percent lands above 100100. Write 8558​ as a percent. Answer with just the number.
Show a hint
  • To get a denominator of 100100, ask what turns 55 into 100100. Since 5×20=1005×20=100, multiply both the top and the bottom by 2020.
  • Multiplying gives 8×205×20=1601005×208×20​=100160​. The numerator over 100100 is the percent.
Show the full solution
Since 5×20=1005×20=100, rewrite 8558​ with a denominator of 100100 by multiplying the top and bottom by 2020. 85=8×205×20=16010058​=5×208×20​=100160​ A fraction over 100100 reads straight off as a percent, so the answer is 160160​. Because 8558​ is bigger than one whole, the percent lands above 100100, exactly as expected.
Problem
A recipe calls for 9889​ cups of oats. Since eighths do not divide 100100 evenly, multiply by 100100 and simplify. Write 9889​ as a percent. Give just the number.
Show a hint
  • To turn a fraction into a percent, multiply it by 100100. So you want 98×10089​×100, which is the same as 90088900​.
  • Now simplify 90088900​ by dividing top and bottom by 44 to get 22522225​, then divide 225225 by 22. It does not come out even, so expect a decimal ending in a half.
Show the full solution
A fraction becomes a percent when you multiply it by 100100. 98×100=9×1008=900889​×100=89×100​=8900​ Divide the top and bottom by 44 to get 22522225​, and 225÷2=112.5225÷2=112.5. So the number is 112.5112.5​. It clears 100100 because 9889​ is more than one whole, and it carries a .5.5 because halving an odd number leaves a half.
Key idea
Fraction to percent. Rescale the fraction so its denominator is 100100. The numerator is then the percent, since percent means out of one hundred. This works cleanly whenever the denominator divides 100100, as with 2,4,5,10,20,25,50,2,4,5,10,20,25,50, and 100100, so 45=80100=80%54​=10080​=80%. When the denominator does not divide 100100, multiply the whole fraction by 100100 instead. That works for every fraction, so 98×100=112.5%89​×100=112.5%.
Problem
Room A chose pizza at 65%65%. Room B chose pizza at 3553​. Convert both to decimals and pick the larger share. Type 11 for Room A or 22 for Room B.
Show a hint
  • You cannot compare a percent and a fraction while they look different. Turn both into decimals first. For the percent, slide the point two places left. For the fraction, divide the top by the bottom.
  • Room A is 65%=0.6565%=0.65. Room B is 35=0.6053​=0.60. Now both are decimals, so just compare 0.650.65 with 0.600.60 and name the option that is bigger.
Show the full solution
Put both shares in decimal form. Room A is 65%65%, and dividing by 100100 slides the point two places left, so 65%=0.6565%=0.65. Room B is 3553​, and 3÷5=0.603÷5=0.60, which you can check with 35=610=0.6053​=106​=0.60. Since 0.65>0.600.65>0.60, Room A has the larger share, option 11​. Values in different forms cannot be judged by eye, so convert them to one shared form first.
Key idea
Three names, one number. A percent, a fraction, and a decimal are three names for the same value. You can convert in either direction, moving the decimal point two places to swap a decimal and a percent, or writing over 100100 to swap a percent and a fraction. The main reason to convert is to compare. Two values in different forms cannot be compared at a glance, so rewrite both in the same form first, usually all decimals or all over 100100. Then you compare them directly.
Problem
A sales tax is 12.5%12.5%. Write 12.5%12.5% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show a hint
  • Percent means per hundred, so start by writing 12.5%12.5% as 12.510010012.5​. A fraction in lowest terms cannot keep a decimal upstairs, so you need to clear that half.
  • Multiply the top and bottom by 1010 to get rid of the decimal point. That turns 12.510010012.5​ into 12510001000125​, and now both numbers are whole and ready to simplify.
Show the full solution
Percent means per hundred, so 12.5%=12.510012.5%=10012.5​. Multiply the top and bottom by 1010 to clear the decimal. 12.5100=12.5×10100×10=125100010012.5​=100×1012.5×10​=1000125​ Both 125125 and 1,0001,000 share the factor 125125, and dividing each by it gives 1/81/8​. Twelve and a half percent being exactly one eighth makes sense, since 1881​ of a hundred is 12.512.5.

Practice these ideas

Practice
A survey found 55%55% of students bike to school. Write 55%55% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show the solution
Percent means "per hundred," so 55%55% is 5555 out of 100100. 55%=5510055%=10055​ Now reduce. The numerator and denominator both share a factor of 55, so divide each by 55. 55100=55÷5100÷5=112010055​=100÷555÷5​=2011​ Since 1111 is prime and does not divide 2020, the fraction is in lowest terms. 11/2011/20​
Practice
A pollster reports 24%24% of people surveyed had never tasted dark chocolate. Write 24%24% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show the solution
The word percent means per hundred, so 24%24% is 2424 out of 100100. 24%=2410024%=10024​ Now simplify. The greatest factor shared by 2424 and 100100 is 44, so divide both the numerator and the denominator by 44. 24100=24÷4100÷4=62510024​=100÷424÷4​=256​ Since 66 and 2525 share no common factor larger than 11, this is fully reduced. 6/256/25​
Practice
A loyalty card stamps your total at 320%320% of last month. Write 320%320% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show the solution
Percent means per hundred, so 320%=320100320%=100320​. The greatest common factor of 320320 and 100100 is 2020, so divide both parts by it. That gives 320÷20100÷20=165100÷20320÷20​=516​. Since 1616 and 55 share no factor bigger than 11, this is lowest terms, and it is more than one whole because 16>516>5. 16/516/5​
Practice
A deep freezer drifted −8%−8% from its set point. Write −8%−8% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show the solution
Percent means per hundred, so the number sits over 100100 and keeps its sign. That gives −8%=−8100−8%=100−8​. The top and bottom share a common factor of 44, so divide both by 44. The numerator becomes −8÷4=−2−8÷4=−2 and the denominator becomes 100÷4=25100÷4=25. Since 22 and 2525 have no common factor left, the fraction is in lowest terms. So −8%−8% equals −2/25−2/25​.
Practice
A weather app says the chance of rain is 73%73%. Write 73%73% as a decimal.
Show the solution
A percent is just a number of hundredths, so 73%73% means 7310010073​. Dividing by 100100 slides the decimal point two places to the left, turning 73.73. into 0.730.73. So the decimal form is 0.730.73​.
Practice
Write 108%108% as a decimal.
Show the solution
To write a percent as a decimal you divide by 100100, which slides the point two places to the left. Begin with 108108, really 108.0108.0, and move the point two places left to land between the 11 and the first 00. So 108%=108100=1.08108%=100108​=1.08​. The result is more than 11 because 108%108% is more than a whole.
Practice
A lab label reads 0.6%0.6% saline. Write 0.6%0.6% as a decimal.
Show the solution
A percent is just a number over 100, so 0.6%0.6% means 0.61001000.6​. Dividing by 100 slides the decimal point two places to the left. Starting from 0.60.6, one place left gives 0.060.06, and a second place gives 0.0060.006, with placeholder zeros filling the gaps. So 0.6%0.6% as a decimal is 0.0060.006​.
Practice
A probe is filled to 0.470.47 of its tank. Write 0.470.47 as a percent. Give just the number.
Show the solution
To turn a decimal into a percent, multiply by 100100, which slides the point two places to the right. So 0.47×100=470.47×100=47, and the number to post is 4747​. It also reads straight off, since 0.47=471000.47=10047​ is already 4747 per hundred.
Practice
A grain of gold dust registers 0.0250.025 of a carat. Write 0.0250.025 as a percent. Give just the number.
Show the solution
To go from a decimal to a percent, multiply by 100100, which slides the decimal point two places to the right. 0.025×100=2.50.025×100=2.5 Sliding the point from 0.0250.025 two places to the right lands between the 22 and the 55, so the value is 2.5%2.5%. The number alone is 2.52.5​.
Practice
A trail map marks 720207​ of its loops as beginner-friendly. Write 720207​ as a percent. Give just the number.
Show the solution
Multiplying 2020 by 55 gives 100100, so multiply the top by 55 as well to keep the same value. 720=7×520×5=35100207​=20×57×5​=10035​ A fraction over 100100 reads straight off as a percent, so the number is 3535​. Rescaling like this works whenever the denominator divides 100100 evenly.
Practice
A juice bottle is 5885​ real fruit. Write 5885​ as a percent. Give just the number.
Show the solution
To turn a fraction into a percent, multiply it by 100100. 58×100=5008=62.585​×100=8500​=62.5 So 5885​ of the bottle is 62.5%62.5% fruit, and the number is 62.562.5​.
Practice
Write 115511​ as a percent. Give just the number.
Show the solution
To write a fraction as a percent, multiply it by 100100. That gives 115×100=1,1005511​×100=51,100​, and 1,100÷5=2201,100÷5=220, so 115=220%511​=220% and the number is 220220​. That checks out, since 115511​ is a bit more than 22 and 220%220% is a bit more than 200%200%.
Practice
A pool is 87.5%87.5% full. Write 87.5%87.5% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show the solution
Percent means per hundred, so 87.5%=87.510087.5%=10087.5​. Multiply the top and bottom by 1010 to clear the decimal, which gives 87510001000875​. Now reduce. Both numbers are divisible by 125125, and 875÷125=7875÷125=7 while 1,000÷125=81,000÷125=8, so the fraction becomes 7887​. Since 77 is prime and does not divide 88, this is lowest terms. 7/87/8​
Practice
Option 1 is 920209​ and option 2 is 44%44%. Which value is larger? Type 11 or 22.
Show the solution
Put both into percent form so they can be compared head to head. For the fraction, scale 920209​ to a denominator of 100100 by multiplying top and bottom by 55, which gives 45100=45%10045​=45%. Now line them up, 45%45% against 44%44%. Since 45%>44%45%>44%, option 1 is the larger value. 11​
